lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible, organized into at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spots exhibit a semi-regular grid pattern with higher density and smaller diameter in the dorsal-anterior region, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (lighter than the background flank) intersect with the horizontal rows of white blobs. These intersections create a visible grid-like structure where the blobs serve as high-intensity nodes at the junctions of the faint vertical and horizontal linear features.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal linear feature is observed running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition—high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and a shadowed low-intensity region immediately below it—extending from the posterior gills towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a scattered distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs. These spots are smaller in diameter compared to the lateral flank blobs and are primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the visible fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, localized region of reddish-brown pixel discoloration is visible on the mid-lateral flank, situated posterior to the primary vertical stripe and below the main horizontal ridge, indicating a physical anomaly or surface lesion.
